21055.overview: You smell the freshly cut grass as you walk out of the dark, cool tunnel into the hot afternoon sun. You hear the crack of leather on wood as the team's power hitter takes batting practice. Today's the day -- you're starting in the big leagues. After warming up in the bullpen, you're ready to take the mound. You get a few last-minute instructions from the pitching coach, and then it's time. Slowly you walk to the center of the diamond. The batter steps in, and you're ready to play ball!

21056.overview: At first it was a technological breakthrough. Humans created the Robotrons -- a species of robots so advanced they didn't need their inventors in order to think and act. But the Robotrons have turned on their creators! They're now determined to destroy humanity -- or reprogram the survivors, turning them into destructive mutants!

22383.overview: Based on the 1985 Bally Midway coin-op, the 7800 was produced by Activision and distributed by Mediagenic. This is a movie-monster game in which you control the beasts and destroy the city.

22384.overview:
Rampart is an unreleased Atari 7800 port of the Atari arcade game of the same name. Your goal in the arcade version of the game is to build up a castle using pieces to form a wall around your territory. After your castle is built, you then place cannons and use them to fire at enemy ships or another player's castle. After each round you then have an opportunity to rebuild your castle before the next round begins.

Unfortunately, the 7800 port of Rampart that is currently available is in an early state and not complete in terms of gameplay or graphics, which is immediately obvious by the lack of a proper title screen. Rampart requires a two-button 7800 joystick. You can select difficulty and number of players, including one player, two players, team or competition modes. Gameplay consists of shooting the enemy targets, which appear as "NME" graphics. The left joystick button fires your normal weapon. The right fire button will destroy all enemies onscreen. If you choose a two player game (team or competition), both players can shoot at enemy targets. There are several different playfield backgrounds depending on the game type selected, or if you play additional games.

A partially compiled version of Rampart was discovered by Curt Vendel, and thanks to the efforts 7800 enthusiasts Robert DeCrescenzo, Mitchell Orman, and Eckhard Stolberg, made playable on 7800 hardware. Internal Atari memos from 1993 mention that the game is almost finalized, so a more complete version of the game must exist somewhere.

22385.overview:
Jet through the cavernous canyons of Fractalus™--in panormic realism. Your fellow pilots are waiting desperately for you. But so are the vicious Jaggi™ aliens. You never know what's going to turn up--or where--until it happens...

In 2004 Curt Vendel of AtariMuseum.com uncovered several Atari 7800 prototypes, including the unreleased game Rescue on Fractalus. While the game is not complete, it is fairly far along, runs pretty smoothly, and can be played with the excellent MESS emulator. To start the game after firing it up, press "R" (Reset) in MESS. There is a glitch in the emulation right now with the rendering of your view outside the cockpit, but we expect this will be fixed in an upcoming release of MESS.

125124.overview:
Rip-Off is a top-down vector shoot 'em up arcade game released by Cinematronics in 1980 and brought to the Atari 7800 by Robert DeCrescenzo. It is the first shoot 'em up arcade game to feature cooperative gameplay and to exhibit flocking behavior.



When you start a new game, your pirate-destroying ship will appear on the right side of the screen. In a two player game, a second pirate-destroying ship will appear on the left side of the screen. Your canisters will be in the center. You must guard your canisters from the pirates who will try to steal them. The pirates can appear from anywhere on the screen. Steer your ship with the joystick for left and right rotation. Move your ship forward by pressing the left button or up on a single button joystick.



Press the right button to fire lasers at the pirates. The pirates can be destroyed by colliding with them, but you will then have to wait for your new pirate-destroying ship to appear before you can fire more lasers. The game is over when all the fuel canisters are stolen.

173073.overview:
An unexpected visit from the Misery Dragon has left Rikki & Vikki with two less children and significantly more inconvenience. Only by mastering a multitude of problematic puzzles can they reach the core of Misery's secret base and rescue the kinder.

Take on the 6 MEGA-POWER challenge alone or with a friend.

Features :
- Six colossal caverns with 100 puzzles to challenge and master.
- High-definition graphics with seven dazzling colors.
- Unique adventures for both one and two players.
- Dynamic difficulty lets you play for story or go for the high score.
- Both foxes and boxes on-screen simultaneously.
- 6 MEGA-POWER of intense inconvenience.

473646.overview:
A thousand years ago, the evil Vampire Mage Ji-Ming ruled with an iron fist, changing people into vampires and making them his slaves.  In his possession was The Staff of No!.  The Staff of No! had tremendous evil power for those who were in possession of it.

A great warrior came to eventually defeat Ji-Ming.  Ji-Ming's soul after his physical destruction became imprisoned in The Staff of No!.  King Liam was given the opportunity to lock up and guard The Staff of No! from anyone daring enough to steal it and gain its power.

King Liam and his Queen Lindia eventually had a son Prince Bill who was a good child at first.  Then at seventeen years of age, he discovered The Staff of No!.  It corrupted Prince Bill.  Now under the influence of The Staff of No!, he murdered his parents and became King.

He eventually took over the surrounding kingdoms to create The Realm of No!.  Only Prince Kori and his kingdom stood in the way of King Bill's evil grasp.  So, Prince Kori summons you, a valiant warrior, to destroy King Bill and his minions!

Do you have the courage to stop King Bill and keep his forces from taking over the entire world?  Well, here's your chance to muster it.  Good Luck!

473655.overview:
In the future, the people of Earth are celebrating Pete Argon's victory over the Amok Bots.  Unfortunately, the Positronic Brain, the leader of the Amok Bots, seems to have escaped!

To counter the threat, Pete Argon returns with his trained right-hand man, Sid Raptor!  Together as a team, the two Robot Fighters must keep the Positronic Brain from reaching Megalopolis and rocketing to the Moon!

However, Pete and Sid must confront more Bots along the way to stop the Positronic Brain.  The miossion will be difficult and strenuous, with plenty of danger along the way.

Can these two courageous Robot Fighters defeat the latest threat by the Bots and thwart the Postronic Brain? Play the game and see!
